name: ProgressListItem
intent: The shared row for a progress-details list. One component covers every WBS level via the variant prop: generic (a zone/category/division grouping — an EV rollup + tool count), task (a work item — name/code + schedule badge, EV strip, progress bar), and object (a physical object — name/code + metrics + progress bar). Rows with an onOpen handler drill into the next level.
when: Rendering a WBS drill-down list (zone → category → division → task → object)
One row component spanning grouping, task, and object levels

chooseOver.because: ProgressListItem is the WBS-specific row with EV/schedule/progress variants; Item is the generic list row

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation

props.name: title
props.description: Primary bold identifier — the level's name.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Secondary muted text — the WBS code, shown beneath the name.

props.name: badge
props.description: Schedule / status badge shown beside the identifier.

props.name: metrics
props.description: Earned-value metric strip (BAC / EV / PV / SV …).

props.name: progress
props.description: Completion percentage → a progress bar + percentage on the right.

props.name: tools
props.description: Linked-tool count, shown with the tree icon.

usage: Use ProgressListItem to display structured data or visualizations. This component helps users understand and interact with complex information sets.

ProgressListItem is ideal for dashboards, reports, and data-heavy interfaces. Ensure data is presented clearly and consider responsive behavior for different screen sizes. Provide appropriate loading states for async data.

anatomy.description: ProgressListItem is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use consistent item spacing
bestPractices.description: Maintain uniform gaps between list items for visual rhythm.

bestPractices.title: Don't vary item spacing
bestPractices.description: Avoid inconsistent gaps that create visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Provide loading states
bestPractices.description: Show skeleton loaders while list data is being fetched.

bestPractices.title: Don't show empty state unexpectedly
bestPractices.description: Always indicate loading vs empty to avoid confusing users.

bestPractices.title: Support keyboard navigation
bestPractices.description: Enable arrow key navigation through list items.

bestPractices.title: Don't break navigation flow
bestPractices.description: Avoid interactive elements that trap focus within items.
